rule_name: Validate Unique QuikActg Company and Account Key
business_name: Company and Account Number Combination Must Be Unique

actual_condition: QuikActg contains 2 records for company code 'A' and plan code '1000'. Each company-and-plan combination must be unique.
message: QuikActg contains 2 records for company code 'A' and plan code '1000'. Each company-and-plan combination must be unique.
